column1: # D1 measurement a, LIVE rows. One row per real edit, written AT THE TIME.
# The statistic over this file is a MEDIAN of minutes, never a mean and
# never a best case. failedEdit means the edit could not be applied or was
# lost, which is the binary-asset failure mode UE is being measured for.
# Rows come from work that was happening anyway. A manufactured cycle
# measures the harness, not the loop.
# EDIT START, FOR THE UE ROWS, IS WHEN THE PREVIOUS ANSWER BECAME READABLE.
# That is genuinely when work began: the loop here is read a landed result,
# edit, dispatch, wait. Both endpoints are landed CI commits with real
# timestamps, traced from git rather than recalled. The first version of
# these rows was written from memory of which run was which and two of the
# three were wrong, in a file whose own header says not to do that.
